scope: Three nonkeyed prevention choice clauses only; unchanged whole-question clinical claims remain open

questionObjectsBefore.question: Which principle best characterizes clinical and imaging diagnosis?
choices: A new infiltrate plus infectious clinical evidence supports HAP or VAP, but no gold standard exists
Two antipseudomonal agents from different classes are reserved for defined resistance risk, poor local susceptibility, or unknown data
The 2026 consensus reserves true beta-lactam dose individualization for regimens informed by measured patient concentrations
Early enteral nutrition is favored and ventilator circuits are changed only when soiled or malfunctioning
questionObjectsBefore.rationale: Critical illness creates many noninfectious mimics

questionObjectsBefore.question: Which principle best characterizes HAP MSSA and gram-negative frame?
choices: Empiric HAP therapy generally covers MSSA and Pseudomonas-active gram-negative organisms
The 2026 consensus reserves true beta-lactam dose individualization for regimens informed by measured patient concentrations
Early enteral nutrition is favored and ventilator circuits are changed only when soiled or malfunctioning
Colonization of an endotracheal tube does not prove invasive pneumonia
questionObjectsBefore.rationale: Nosocomial gram-negative coverage is part of the baseline frame

questionObjectsBefore.question: Which principle best characterizes definitive MRSA therapy?
choices: Vancomycin or linezolid is recommended for proven MRSA HAP or VAP
Early enteral nutrition is favored and ventilator circuits are changed only when soiled or malfunctioning
Colonization of an endotracheal tube does not prove invasive pneumonia
Use two antipseudomonal classes when resistance risk exists, more than 10 percent of isolates resist the proposed monotherapy, or susceptibility data are unavailable

sourceComparison.nutrition: Preserve early enteral versus parenteral comparison in eligible adult mechanical-ventilation context; no universal instruction to feed despite contraindication.
sourceComparison.circuits: Visibly soiled/malfunctioning indication plus manufacturer exception. No invented outcome benefit from circuit replacement.
